m.t: Ne každý den se mí rodiče berou.
m.e: It's not every day that my parents get married.

m.t: Tohle jsou lodě, který jsou v přístavu, nebo brzy připlujou a berou cestující.
m.e: These are the ships either in port or soon expected to be... and willing to accept passengers.

m.t: Odkud se všichni tyhle podělaný lidi berou?
m.e: - Where are all these fucking people coming from?

m.t: Copak nechceš vědět, kde se mimina berou?
m.e: Don't you wanna know... where babies really come from?

m.t: Berou nevinné lidi... zlomené lidi... nalákají je dovnitř a nenechají je odejít.
m.e: They take innocent people... broken people... they lure them in and they don't let them leave.

m.t: Říkali, že ho berou do vězení.
m.e: Said they're taking him to prison.

m.t: Oni si fakt berou moje auto?
m.e: Are they really gonna take my car?

m.t: Rostliny si berou vodu z půdy.
m.e: Plants take in water from the soil.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4423535 by lipao; English translation #268575 by CK

m.t: - Berou si ji, kousek po kousku.
m.e: - They're taking it away bit by bit.

m.t: Zdá se, že psi na sebe berou lidskou podobu a infiltrují nejvyšší vládní místa.
m.e: Apparently, dogs are taking on human form and they are infiltrating the highest levels of our government.

m.t: Znám místo, kde berou Discovery kartu.
m.e: I know a place that takes Discovery card.

m.t: CO, to dneska berou každého?
m.e: What, are they taking anybody these days?

m.t: Lidé si berou vlastní život.
m.e: People taking their own lives.

m.t: Všichni ho berou tak vážně.
m.e: And everybody takes it so seriously.

m.t: Kde vůbec berou ty nápady?
m.e: Where do they even get these ideas?

m.t: - Kde tihle lidi berou peníze?
m.e: Where do these people get their money?

m.t: Berou nám naši svobodu.
m.e: They are taking our liberty from us.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9843205 by Ergulis; English translation #9843206 by Ergulis

m.t: Kde tedy berou peníze?
m.e: So where are they getting the money?

m.t: Tom a Mary se za pár měsíců berou.
m.e: Tom and Mary are getting married in a few months.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8108153 by Ergulis; English translation #8107741 by CK

m.t: Nevěděl jsem, co je v krabici, pouze jsem to podepsal.
m.e: I didn't know what was in the box, I just signed for it.

m.t: Brácho, přečetl sis vůbec cos podepsal, když jsi tady začal dělat?
m.e: Bro, did you even happen to read what you signed when you started working for this place?

m.t: Jít do gay klubu je, jako by sis podepsal rozsudek smrti.
m.e: Walking into a gay club is signing your death warrant.

m.t: Podepsal jste jeho ročenku, kterou jsme našli u něj v bytě.
m.e: You signed his yearbook. We found it at his apartment.

m.t: Věřím, že je naší povinností vykonávat příkazy, které podepsal prezident.
m.e: I believe it is our duty to carry out the orders that the president signed.

m.t: Když ses naposledy snažil pomoct, podepsal jsi smlouvu s Řádem na milion let.
m.e: And the last time you tried to help, you signed, like, a billion-year contract with The Order.

m.t: Potřebuju někoho, aby podepsal tuhle objednávku alkoholu.
m.e: I need for someone to sign this liquor shipment.

m.t: Ale prezident Todd podepsal propuštění vězňů, jak chtěli.
m.e: But President Todd authorized the release of the prisoner they asked for.

m.t: Vaše Ctihodnosti, je dost možné, že donutil toho profesora Gerarda, aby to podepsal.
m.e: Your Honor, there's a good chance he coerced this Professor Gerard into signing this thing.

m.t: Zrovna jsem podepsal smlouvu tady s Fawn.
m.e: Uh, I just signed Fawn, here.

m.t: Kromě té části, kde to podepsal.
m.e: Except for the part where he signed it.

m.t: To jen proto, abys podepsal smlouvu.
m.e: That was just to get you to sign the contract.

m.t: Tak máme čas, abys to podepsal.
m.e: Then we have time for you to sign this.

m.t: Podepsal jsem se pod tu petici.
m.e: I signed the petition.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9802772 by Ergulis; English translation #9029288 by CK

m.t: Poručík Hoffman se pod to podepsal.
m.e: Lieutenant Hoffman signed off on it.

m.t: Podepsal jsem na svém místě ACU.
m.e: I signed on with the ACU.

m.t: Už jsem to podepsal u Hachette.
m.e: I already signed the contract with Hachette.

m.t: Mrkni se, kdo to podepsal.
m.e: So look who signed it.

m.t: - Je to ona, a už jsem podepsal převzetí.
m.e: - Her, and I already signed for her.

m.t: - Podepsal byste petici, abychom mohli to šílenství ukončit?
m.e: Would you be willing to sign this petition so that we can put an end to this madness?

m.t: Nechtěj po něm, aby se ti podepsal
m.e: Don't ask him to sign

m.t: Podepsal jsi tu šílenou smlouvu?
m.e: You signed that insane contract?

m.t: Potřebujeme stvrzenku, kterou podepsal pan Smith.
m.e: We need the receipt that Mr. Smith signed.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6811506 by Ergulis; English translation #6766880 by AlanF_US

m.t: Jo, zrovna podepsal povolení.
m.e: Yep, he just signed the warrant.

m.t: Tak jsi to podepsal.
m.e: Well, you signed the thing.

m.t: Celej tým se podepsal.
m.e: The whole team signed.

m.t: Tom podepsal petici za zákaz kožešinových farem.
m.e: Tom signed a petition to ban fur farms.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7957765 by Ergulis; English translation #7957778 by Ergulis

m.t: Tom podepsal novou smlouvu.
m.e: Tom has signed a new contract.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8468554 by lovermann; English translation #4665209 by CK

m.t: Tom podepsal několik petic.
m.e: Tom signed several petitions.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11949218 by Ergulis; English translation #11949219 by Ergulis
